title: On Persuading the elders to wait a year
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：persuade　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 persuade 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the farmer ① persuaded the elders to wait a year at once, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② persuades the elders to wait a year in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ persuade the elders to wait a year at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ persuaded the elders to wait a year before — a line in the almanac for September 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Persuading the elders to wait a year at once, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ persuade them the news was false in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Persuade them the news was false at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ persuades them the news was false at once every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ persuaded the elders to wait a year again when nobody else would.

⑩ To persuade the elders to wait a year, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody persuades the elders to wait a year in the rain again and somebody must persuade the elders to wait a year at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 说服（一般过去式 persuaded the elders to wait a year：1991 年农人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 说服（一般现在 persuades the elders to wait a year：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 说服（不定式 to persuade the elders to wait a year：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 说服（过去完成时 had persuaded the elders to wait a year：1985 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 说服（动名词 persuading the elders to wait a year 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使相信（persuade them the news was false：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使相信使他们相信那消息不实）
G. v. 使相信（persuade them the news was false：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 说服（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 persuades them the news was false，而母亲又一次 persuaded the elders to wait a year）

answers.why: persuade 意为“说服”，1991 年农人二话不说地说服说服长辈再等上一年，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 persuaded。
persuade 意为“说服”，自那以后农人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 persuades。
persuade 意为“说服”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯说服说服长辈再等上一年”，此处为不定式 to persuade the elders to wait a year。
persuade 意为“说服”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人说服过，故用过去完成时 had persuaded。
persuade 意为“说服”，农人说“说服说服长辈再等上一年这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 persuading the elders to wait a year 作主语。
persuade 意为“使相信”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使相信使他们相信那消息不实”，should ever 之后用原形 persuade them the news was false。
persuade 意为“使相信”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使相信使他们相信那消息不实（persuade them the news was false at once），以后再也不要提起。
persuade 意为“说服”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例使相信使他们相信那消息不实，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 persuades。
persuade 意为“说服”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地说服说服长辈再等上一年，用一般过去式 persuaded 叙述。
persuade 意为“说服”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要说服说服长辈再等上一年，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 persuade 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the farmer persuaded the elders to wait a year at once, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer persuades the elders to wait a year in the rain whenever the field asks.
Persuading the elders to wait a year at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever persuade them the news was false in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field persuades them the news was false at once every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother persuaded the elders to wait a year again, and the field remembered that half.
